notes:
**S170-notes.** The page proposes a definition of a special or n-galoisienne n-category by locally constant (n−1)-champs, and a second formulation using n-functors from a groupoid. It names the fundamental n-groupoid, local n-systems and geometric realization, then proposes recovering the groupoid inside an underlined Hom category using exactness. These proposals are not proved here. The writer’s own qualifications are “ce qui doit revenir au” followed by the equals-like abbreviation, “doit s’interpréter,” “on a envie de dire,” and the unfinished “Il est prudent dans tout.”

The source and target written in Hom and in the immediately following functor expression agree. Reader A compared those written endpoints (scan170-S3-Hom-description); this is recorded as visual consistency reading, not a mathematical proof check. The ink says **n-systèmes**, while the earlier definition says **(n−1)-champs**; neither the transcription nor the notes silently alters the rank. Mathematical expectation suggests inverse limits in the first limit expression, but its arrowhead remains visually uncertain. The live G after the cancelled symbol is read as an interrupted G bowl, with no separate hat.

This is a handwritten letter continuation, author page **25**, archival pencil number **170**. There is no date, title, salutation, signature or stated total page count on this sheet. The pale hooked interlinear stroke below “nous” is reproduced without assigning it meaning or certain authorship.
